result.description: Compact field recorder with dual XLR/TRS inputs, 24-bit/96 kHz capture, onboard stereo microphones, and 24GB internal solid-state storage for location interviews, podcasts, and ambient sound collection. Includes USB-C charging, timecode-compatible sync, low-noise preamps, and a lightweight matte-black chassis designed for handheld or bag-based workflows.
result.title: Nimbus Quill 24GB Portable Audio Recorder
